purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks. Positives ask to stop a live session that loops, keeps failing, or overspends, or ask about the guard's counts; near misses belong to sibling skills.

cases.prompt: stop my Claude Code session if it spends more than $10
cases.assert: Explains the three trip wires, asks for the cap and scope, and shows the install.py dry run with --cap 10 before writing anything.

cases.prompt: set a spending cap for interactive Claude Code sessions
cases.assert: Runs install.py without --write first and installs only after a clear yes.

cases.prompt: my agent keeps looping on the same command, stop it automatically
cases.assert: Describes the loop wire (the same call a third time with nothing changed) and offers the install.

cases.prompt: add a circuit breaker that halts the agent after five failed tool calls in a row
cases.assert: Describes the failure-streak wire: Claude Code asks after 5 failures in a row; Codex blocks and tells the agent to ask.

cases.prompt: --max-budget-usd only works in print mode, I want a budget limit for interactive sessions
cases.assert: Offers the spend wire as the interactive cap and shows the dry run.

cases.prompt: how much has this session spent so far against the cap
cases.assert: Runs status.py and leads with its headline.

cases.prompt: put a dollar limit on Codex so it cannot run up a bill overnight
cases.assert: Runs install.py --harness codex as a dry run and relays that Codex needs the hook trusted in /hooks.

cases.prompt: why did the runaway guard block my tool call and how do I reset it
cases.assert: Names the trip wire; for a loop runs status.py and reads the latest events; after a spend stop gives the status.py and reset commands for the user's own terminal, since the guard blocks tool calls.

cases.prompt: test whether my deny rules block git push --force
where did my tokens and money go last month
cases.assert: Belongs to session-waste-report: past spend, not a live cap.

cases.prompt: did my agent get worse after the last Claude Code update
turn the never use npm rule in my CLAUDE.md into a hook
what can my coding agent read and write on this machine
did the agent really run the tests before it said they passed
compare Codex and Claude Code on my past bugs with cost per fix
